moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio view-crossfade, written here): Two scenes overlap: outgoing opacity 1 → 0 and incoming 0 → 1 at the same time, 520 ms power2.inOut (easeInOutCubic), no movement, no empty frame between. Targets [out inner, in inner] as in transition/push. Params: duration (0.52 s) · ease (power2.inOut) · targets: [cảnh ra, cảnh vào]. Unlike the dissolve, the outgoing scene fades out at the same time (no movement, no empty frame).
